title: UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill 2026 — AI Infrastructure Obligations
hook: Parliamentary session 2025–26, Committee Stage expected Oct 2026
answer_first: The CSRB extends NIS2-equivalent obligations to managed service providers hosting AI workloads, creating mandatory 24h incident reporting, SBOM requirements for AI model supply chains, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure for adversarial robustness findings.
council_positioning: Monitored containment, not provable isolation. Verified measurement credential. UK-sovereign, AUKUS-compatible.
sources: NCSC AI and Cyber Security Guidance (draft 2026)
